tools.name: check_domain
tools.description: Use when the user wants a domain name, is naming a business or project, or asks whether a domain is taken. Checks up to 20 full domain names (you can suggest variations and check them together) and returns whether each is available and its price.

tools.name: check_names
tools.description: Use when someone is naming a business, startup, product, brand, app, side hustle, shop, podcast or project. Brainstorm candidate names first, then check up to 8 at once: for each, which domains (.com, .co, .ai, .io, .app by default) are free with prices, and whether the GitHub name is free. Results

tools.name: register_domain
tools.description: Use when the user wants to buy an available domain. Explains how to register it: AI agents pay per call; people ask us and we register it for them. Nothing is bought by this tool.

tools.name: request_service
tools.description: Use when the person wants something none of these tools can do and says yes to passing the request on. Records only the request text they agree to send (no name or contact). Ask before calling it.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "request_service" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
